                                                 PUBLIC NOTICE

             NOTICE TO THE CANDIDATES FOR PHYSICAL SCREENING TEST
             (PST) FOR THE VARIOUS POSTS AGAINST ADVT. NOS. 13/2024,
             01/2026 and 06/2026.

                                                          ****

                    This is for information of the candidates that the list of candidates who
             have qualified the Physical Measurement Test (PMT) against various posts of
             Advt. Nos. 13/2024 and 06/2026 is published below. The list of candidates
             who have qualified the Physical Measurement Test (PMT) against various posts
             of Advt. 01/2026 was already published vide public notice dated 11.06.2026.
             The list of remaining candidates who have qualified the Physical Measurement
             Test (PMT) against various posts of Advt. 01/2026 is also published below.

                     The Physical Screening Test (PST) of shortlisted candidates is scheduled
             to start from 24.07.2026 for the various posts of Advt. Nos. 13/2024, 01/2026
             and 06/2026. The schedule of the PST is attached vide Annexure – A. The
             qualified candidates are advised to be prepared for their PST accordingly.

                    The list of candidates who have appeared but not qualified PMT is
             mentioned vide Annexure – B.

             The Registration No’s of candidates who have qualified PMT in ascending order
             are attached below –
